Package controller

Class EditCommand

  • java.lang.Object
    • controller.Command
      • controller.EditCommand
  • public class EditCommand
extends Command
    This class is a generic class to represent two functionalities ie edit event and edit calendar. This class delegates the functionality to the EditCalendarCommand class if it encounters the "calendar" keyword and EditEventCommand class if "event" keyword is encountered.
